card.name: Subject words in literary prose
card.fires_on: Short subject-like words such as "one" after "no", "Several", "me" after "seems to", or "wife", in older literary, historical or religious prose. It fires at the point where the sentence is about to give a verb or statement.

modes.label: "no one" and similar
modes.description: The word "one" after "no" as the start of a clause about a person.
modes.example: No<< one>> took his life from him.
